name: scaffold-template-library
body: Scaffold template library: create a new empty but valid library at a target path — write `library.yaml` (name derived from the directory base name and validated against the `[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*` identifier convention, `format: 1`) and the empty standard layout entries `slides/`, `sections/`, `themes/` and `media/`; refuse to clobber an existing library (a present `library.yaml` or any layout entry) with no `--force`; local filesystem only (no network, no git).
